scope.adjudication: Typography-only variants are frozen without matcher, scanner, scorer, prediction, or private-source inspection. Parent expected literal values, decisions, challenges and unit links are unchanged; all coordinates are remapped against the changed source.

transformation.scope: Every parent document, exactly one variant each, document ID prefixed marked_; no semantic re-adjudication.
transformation.physical_lines: Split on LF only, retain CRLF and all original characters; horizontal indentation may be ASCII space, tab or NBSP.
transformation.code_recognition: For recognition only, NFC-normalize a whole initial token of 1–4 Spanish letters A–Z/áéíóúüñ and 1–4 ASCII digits; preserve its original source bytes and code points.
transformation.label_recognition: After the code and at least one horizontal space, require case-insensitive ASCII PDA, optional horizontal space, one or more ASCII digits and a colon.
transformation.edit: Insert one ASCII hyphen immediately before the initial code after any horizontal indentation. Existing hyphens, doubled markers, bullets, inline labels, missing colons, noncoded labels and malformed codes receive no insertion.
transformation.safety: Apply the typography transform equally in positive and adversarial contexts; it never determines eligibility, scope or truth.
transformation.span_remapping: For each original span, shift start by insertions <= start and end by insertions < end. Verify the resulting page slice equals the original quote. Apply recursively to every unit, declaration, challenge and context witness.
transformation.expected_policy: Preserve all parent expected fields and literal quotes exactly. Opportunities remain source strata, not promises of baseline deltas or recoverability.

admission: A clean page start or recognized unit permits a canonical formative-field header, bare or with Campo, Campos, or Campo formativo prefix.

A Spanish local code with 1–4 letters and 1–4 digits, then a literal dot, introduces a complete descriptor of 1–8 physical lines immediately followed by explicit coded numbered PDA labels; one hyphen is optional.
Descriptor and PDA codes are syntactic local evidence only: no code equality, identity, relationship, curriculum match, content declaration, or unit inference is asserted.
An ordinary colon is permitted in a descriptor; typed labels, activities, examples, nonadoption, quotes, table syntax, and controls are not.

A subsequent descriptor or canonical/compositionally abbreviated field closes a prior complete PDA only when corroborated by a complete descriptor/PDA block. An incomplete prior value blocks the rest of the block.

A transition can abbreviate exactly one interior word as its initial and dot while keeping first/last words and original punctuation; at most three physical lines are permitted. An abbreviation alone cannot open a region.
Examples, activities, unknown headings, and quotes remain blockers until an actual recognized unit; fields do not reset them.
No descriptor, field, value, or unit is inherited across pages. Every new literal is pda, abstained/unresolved_scope, and unit_id null.
